units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 11:8">Kel. XI, 8</cite> <he>ק׳ שחוליות שלה וכ׳</he> a chain the links of which are of metal and strung on a linen or a woolen thread.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 11:8">Ib.</cite> <he>שירי ק׳ וכ׳</he> the fragments of a necklace (in order to be susceptible of levitical uncleanness) must be large enough &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 1:9">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. I, 9</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="S00295"><he>קַטְלָאוֹת</he></cite>, <he>קַטְלָיוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 1:13">Ib. 13</cite>; Kel. l. c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 1:8">Ab. Zar. I, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 19b:15">19ᵇ</cite>) <he>אין עושין … קוטלאות וכ׳</he> (omitted in Y. ed.) you must not manufacture jewelry for idols: necklaces &c.; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:18">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>שירין וקַטְלִין וכ׳</he> chains, necklaces &c.
